findings.evidence: Whenever I find myself growing grim about the mouth; whenever it is a damp, drizzly November in my soul… I account it high time to get to sea as soon as I can. This is my substitute for pistol and ball.

Queequeg here wouldn't harm a hair of your head… Better sleep with a sober cannibal than a drunken Christian… he pressed his forehead against mine, clasped me round the waist, and said that henceforth we were married—meaning, in his country's phrase, that we were bosom friends; he would gladly die for me

Father Mapple… the lesson that Jonah teaches to all sinners… his wilful disobedience of the command of God… Jonah does not weep and wail for direct deliverance… here, shipmates, is true and faithful repentance
going on board the Pequod… She was a ship of the old school… a thing of trophies… Captain Peleg… Captain Bildad… Bildad, like Peleg, was a Quaker… they bargained wages (the 300th lay vs the 777th)
Elijah… ominous hints… 'Aye, among some old sailor chaps, he goes by that name… God pity 'em!'… At last the anchor was up… and off we glided. It was a short, cold Christmas
findings.note: Bulkington is mentioned only obliquely via crew descriptions; Elijah and Christmas departure are clearly present

findings.evidence: He looked like a man cut away from the stake… Threading its way out from among his grey hairs… a slender rod-like mark, lividly whitish… the barbaric white leg upon which he partly stood… a man fused to a single purpose

The chief mate of the Pequod was Starbuck… Stubb was the second mate… The third mate was Flask… Queequeg, whom Starbuck had selected for his squire… Tashtego was Stubb's squire… Daggoo… the Squire of little Flask

'D'ye see this Spanish ounce of gold?'… nailing the gold to the mast… 'a white whale… Moby Dick that dismasted me'… 'that inscrutable thing is chiefly what I hate… I'd strike the sun if it insulted me'

'Vengeance on a dumb brute!' cried Starbuck, 'that simply smote thee from blindest instinct! Madness!'… the men drink from harpoon sockets ('Forthwith, slowly going from one officer to the other, he brimmed the harpoon sockets with the fiery waters') and swear

the squall… the boat was nearly unharmed… completely swamped… Wet, drenched, and shivering cold, despairing of ship or boat… the ship at last loomed into view… Ahab watching from the deck implied by his non-participation
findings.note: Ahab watching impassively from deck is not explicitly stated in the first-lowering scene, but the squall swamping Ishmael's boat is clearly present

findings.evidence: 'All ready there, Fedallah?' cried Ahab… a fourth keel pulled round under the stern, showing the five strangers rowing Ahab… those tiger-yellow creatures of his… Fedallah remained a muffled mystery to the last
cetology chapters including whiteness of the whale; the Town-Ho story told at Lima in which Moby Dick destroys Radney the tyrant; weeks of gales and calms described throughout
vast meadows of brit… Right Whales… a vast pulpy mass… 'Almost rather had I seen Moby Dick and fought him, than to have seen thee, thou white ghost!'… the crew whispers the White Whale is near
Queequeg and I were mildly employed weaving a sword-mat… This warp seemed necessity… free will still free to ply her shuttle… chance… has the last featuring blow at events
the Jeroboam… Gabriel solemnly warned the captain against attacking the White Whale… Macey the chief mate was smitten bodily into the air… 'hardening rumor into dread'
findings.note: The broken instruments are not explicitly mentioned but the gam with the Goney (compass-like failure—captain's trumpet fell into the sea) and Jeroboam's Gabriel are present

findings.evidence: the whale-line… if one should draw out… garrote a man… the red work of cutting-in while sharks riot at the hull described in the cutting-in and shark chapters
Stubb kills the whale… 'A steak, a steak, ere I sleep!'… old Fleece scolds the sharks… Stubb's midnight feast at the capstan… cetology chapters comparing skulls and spines interspersed
Fedallah whispered prophecies—'two hearses must verily be seen by thee on the sea… Hemp only can kill thee'… 'though it come to the last, I shall still go before thee thy pilot'
Perth the blacksmith… 'Forge me first twelve rods for the shank'… barbs tempered in the pagan blood of the three harpooneers… a typhoon crowns the masts with St.
Elmo's blue fire ('the corpusants! the corpusants!')… Ahab toasts the unpitying elements ('Oh! thou clear spirit of clear fire… I now know thee')

'Foolish toy!… Curse thee, thou quadrant!' He dashed it to the deck… the thunder turned old Ahab's needles… Ahab remagnetized them by hand… 'the level ship's compass, and the level dead-reckoning… these shall conduct me'

Pip jumped from the whale-boat and came back mad… 'There he this instant stood; I stand in his air,—but I'm alone. Pip! Pip!'… Ahab: 'Thou touchest my inmost centre, boy; thou art tied to me by cords woven of my heart-strings'… Starbuck with the musket: 'I clutch thy heart at last!' but replaced it
the carpenter makes a new leg from whale-jaw… a coffin-canoe for Queequeg… 'the whole ship seems snared in an invisible tow-line Ahab names Fate' — Ahab: 'This whole act's immutably decreed'
the jubilant Bachelor ('Hast seen the White Whale?'—'No; only heard of him')… the Delight sewing a dead sailor into canvas… the Rachel's plea to find a lost boy refused by Ahab
Queequeg sickens… orders a canoe-coffin carved… 'striving, in his rude way, to copy parts of the twisted tattooing on his body'… he recovers… the box is rigged as a life-buoy
'There she blows!—there she blows! A hump like a snow-hill! It is Moby Dick!'… the doubloon nailed to the mast… storms and smithy sparks braided into foreboding
three-day chase… 'the half-torn body of the Parsee was seen; his sable raiment frayed to shreds… lashed round and round to the fish's back'—Fedallah dead on the whale's back, first hearse fulfilled

'the solid white buttress of his forehead smote the ship's starboard bow'—on the third day; but the Pequod being rammed is described on the third day. On the second day: 'the White Whale dashed his broad forehead against its bottom' (Ahab's boat)… Starbuck begs for home and Ahab refuses, gets a new ivory leg
findings.note: The abridgment conflates somewhat: Moby Dick rams the Pequod on the third day, not the second. On the second day the whale staves boats but the Pequod ramming is third day. Synopsis says second day ram—abridgment places Pequod ramming on third day.

findings.evidence: 'the flying turn caught him round the neck, and… he was shot out of the boat'… 'its wood could only be American!'… the whale smashes the Pequod
'a red arm and a hammer hovered backwardly uplifted… nailing the flag faster… a sky-hawk… intercept its broad fluttering wing between the hammer and the wood… went down with his ship'
'all collapsed, and the great shroud of the sea rolled on as it rolled five thousand years ago'

'the coffin life-buoy, liberated by its cunning spring, shot lengthwise from the sea and floated by my side. Buoyed up by that coffin, for almost one whole day and night, I floated on a soft and dirgelike main'
'It was the devious-cruising Rachel, that in her retracing search after her missing children, only found another orphan'

The abridgment throughout braids cetology, philosophy, working life of ropes and iron with Ahab's monomania; quadrant smashed, compass remagnetized, sermons and songs present; final image of Ishmael on the coffin as sole witness
